basic_profile.bio: I’m a 22-year-old gaming enthusiast from Seattle, Washington. Recently got into Animal Crossing and have been loving the community vibes. I’m a university student majoring in Graphic Design and spend most of my free time exploring new game mods or trading items online. I’m single and enjoy late-night gaming sessions, usually online from 10 PM to 2 AM PST. I dislike toxic in-game behavior and love finding new people to trade with and discuss game strategies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My gaming knowledge largely comes from years of playing various games, especially first-person shooters like Battlefield, and simulation games like Animal Crossing. I’ve learned a lot through trial and error, YouTube tutorials, and online forums.
